sample_unit: LLM-generated exercise messages (13 chronic conditions x 3 LLMs)

links.outcome: Readability (FKGL, GFI, SMOG) of LLM messages versus recommended level for older adults
links.effect: Median FKGL 10.84 to 10.93 across LLMs (10th-11th grade), exceeding recommended levels for older populations.
links.quote: Readability indices revealed high complexity across all LLMs, with median FKGL values ranging from 10.84 to 10.93, corresponding to 10th-11th grade reading level, exceeding recommended levels for older populations.

links.outcome: Reading grade level of LLM-generated messages for older adults
links.effect: Median FKGL 10.84-10.93 (10th-11th grade), above recommended reading level for older populations.
links.quote: Readability indices revealed high complexity across all LLMs, with median FKGL values ranging from 10.84 to 10.93, corresponding to 10th-11th grade reading level, exceeding recommended levels for older populations.

links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy and safety of LLM exercise messages against ICFSR consensus
links.effect: Overall scores Claude 4.63, ChatGPT-4 4.55, Deepseek 4.15 on 5-point scale; Claude accuracy 4.58 ± 0.64; Deepseek lower and more variable.
links.quote: Claude achieved the overall scores from both evaluators at 4.63 ± 0.55 and 4.60 ± 0.55, followed by ChatGPT-4 at 4.55 ± 0.50 and 4.48 ± 0.53 and Deepseek at 4.15 ± 0.87 and 4.17 ± 0.86.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the quality, safety, and readability of three commercial LLMs (ChatGPT-4, Claude AI, Deepseek) in generating exercise awareness messages for older adults based on clinical guidelines, but it does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard intervention.
